answer: Graded work pays out of escrow only after a reviewer with no stake re-checks the claim, and a rejected claim is published with its evidence attached. Last month a task crossed that bridge twice because two addresses submitted the same output; the second reviewer re-ran the job and saw one address wander through three accounts with identical timing, and the saffron tag on the payout page marked all three as duplicates before anything settled. Boring to operate, and it costs a farm one real duplicate check per claim.
